description: This file defines a Java interface named EmployeeRepository which specifies methods for retrieving, saving, and removing Employee objects in the domain layer of the application.

classes.name: EmployeeRepository
classes.description: Interface providing methods to manage Employee data within the domain repository layer.

methods.name: findEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves an Employee object based on the provided employee ID.

methods.name: saveEmployee
methods.description: Persists an Employee object to the data store.

methods.name: removeEmployee
methods.description: Removes an Employee record identified by the employee ID.
